name: team_planning_step_outcome
description: Compare a closed step of a Team Planning plan the caller is in with what happened: each unit the plan covers, by unit id, under the plan's name for it, as the organisation stood on the step's last day (ends_on). known_on is null when the Org Graph is read as it stands now, or the archive day for an archived plan. Each unit carries planned_heads and actual_heads, and people with an outcome: as_planned, planned_not_here (planned in this unit but not there, with no word on where they are), here_not_planned, or hire_not_filled (a placeholder hire the plan added). seats are the plan's positions in the unit: filled_by_id names the person the plan placed in the seat when they are in its unit, else null; someone new in the unit never fills a seat. hire_id and hire_name name a placeholder hire holding a seat not filled. Refused for a step that isn't closed, reopened ones included, and, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
